attributes.title: Template attributes
attributes.subtitle: Variables you can drop into any message body. Each one fills in from the contact when the message is sent.

how.title: How attributes work
how.body: Type / in any message body to open the picker. Picking an attribute inserts its token, which is replaced by the contact's value (or the default) when the message is sent.

token.text: Inserted by its key, e.g. order_id

when.title: When to add one
when.body: If a value is not already on the contact (like an order ID, coupon code, or appointment time), add it as an attribute so templates can fill it in.

rules.title: Keys are permanent
rules.body: A key is used in your templates and flows, so it cannot be changed once created. The display name and default can be edited any time.

naming.title: Naming tips
naming.body: Use snake_case for keys and keep names short and consistent: order_id, tracking_url, discount_code, appointment_at.

tip.title: Default values save you
tip.body: Set a default for every attribute. If a contact is missing that value at send time, the default is used instead of the message failing or showing a blank slot.

stage.help: Every contact is in exactly one stage: where the person is in your sales journey. Drag the rows or use the arrows to set the order they are offered in.
stage.unconfigured: This workspace has not set up its own stages, so contacts use the ten standard ones. Customise them to rename, recolour, reorder, add or remove stages.

how.title: How stages work
how.body: A contact starts in the default stage. Change it from the contacts table, the contact page or the edit form. Statuses can belong to a stage, so changing the stage may change the status too. Deleting a stage that contacts are in asks where to move them.

status.help: A stage is where a contact is in your sales journey; a status is a step inside it, such as Quote sent while Qualified, or Not interested while Lost. Leave a status on All stages for labels like Do not contact.
status.unconfigured: This workspace has not set up its own statuses, so contacts use Active, Prospect, Customer and VIP. Customise them to make them yours.

how.title: How statuses work
how.body: A status can apply to all stages or to one. A contact only offers the statuses that fit its stage, and moving it to another stage resets the status to that stage's default, or clears it when there is none. Deleting a status that contacts hold asks where to move them.
